_comment: GH#330 R3 canonical: the Wounded Corusdeer's payoff arc, end to end. Fixture gh330_deer_arc_start puts a [Beast Tamer] 5 at floodplains (33,10) facing the deer with tended_beasts already at 10, so the prop renders the STANDING corusdeer_doe before a single press. Legs: (1) BEFORE -- corusdeer_range still offers the shipped [Basic Command] row, visible-locked/unlocked as authored, and [Back away.] closes without combat; (2) THE CLOSE -- one tend banks the NEW corusdeer_healed with the arc's closing toast, and the deer is gone from the map (present_when.absent) rather than a lever forever; (3) WHAT IT LEAVES -- worn_grass_patch now stands on the deer's own cell (33,9) and hands over the one-time shed_antler, and a SECOND read hands over nothing (the frozen_cache variant-zeroing shape); (4) THE VOUCH -- corusdeer_range's node has swapped rows: the [Basic Command] soothe is hidden and an UNGATED soothe stands in its place, and taking it banks the same tended_beasts + dormant close. Windowed shots 00/01 are the eye-gate for the stand-up rig.

steps._comment: The stand-up beat: at tended_beasts 10 the prop's visual_states row swaps the lying corusdeer for the corusdeer_doe rig, untinted. This shot is the eye-gate.
== (1) BEFORE == corusdeer_range (36,6) still carries the shipped [Basic Command] row. Approach from (36,8): up 1 -> (36,7), up 1 blocks on the encounter and faces it.

options.text: [Basic Command] Steady it. Slow words, open hands.

steps._comment: [Back away.] -- leaves the herd's stray untouched so the arc's own tend is the next bank.
== (2) THE CLOSE == back to the deer. One tend at tended_beasts >= 10 banks corusdeer_healed, not tended_beasts.

payload_contains.text: It is standing when you come up, weight on all four legs. You get one hand down the leg before it swings away from you and takes the rise at a trot.

steps._comment: THE POINT OF THE ISSUE: tended_beasts did NOT move. The deer stopped being a producer.
== (3) WHAT IT LEAVES == the deer's own cell (33,9) now holds worn_grass_patch. The player is still at (33,10) facing up, so the same press reaches the new prop.
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: ONE-TIME: the second read hands over nothing and says so.
steps.name: interact

payload_contains.text: Only the hollow in the grass now, and it is filling in.

steps._comment: == (4) THE VOUCH == the herd's stray knows your scent. The shipped [Basic Command] row is HIDDEN and an ungated soothe stands where it was -- same three options, no skill requirement.

options.text: Steady it. The herd knows your hands now.
